message:
Prompt tools: reverse-prompt, prompt enhancement, inspiration library (#57)

* feat: prompt tools — reverse-prompt, prompt enhancement, inspiration library

- POST /api/images/reverse-prompt: image-to-prompt via a vision-capable chat
  model (concise/standard/detailed), ownership + mime + vision gates, rate
  limited like /generate
- POST /api/images/enhance-prompt: expands a terse prompt into a full
  generation prompt through the same model resolution and vision gate
- promptEngineering.js: the two system prompts (concrete optical/lighting/
  material/palette language, in-image text transcribed verbatim with
  position, no quality filler)
- shared: REVERSE_PROMPT_LENGTHS contract + 100-entry curated inspiration
  prompt library (imported directly — browsing is offline, zero tokens)
- frontend: Reverse prompt action on chat attachment cards and gallery cards
  with a result modal (length selector, insert, copy); transparent two-step
  Enhance toggle in image mode (expand into composer, edit, confirm with one
  more submit) with a vision-model picker; inspiration panel off a lightbulb
  with fuzzysort search, category chips and persisted favorites
- pendingPrompt uiState flow: one canonical insert-into-composer path for
  chat cards, gallery and inspiration, no prop drilling

Spec: specs/reverse-prompt-and-enhancement.md (all 12 TDD cycles green)

* docs: closeout log for prompt tools (PR #57)

* style: fix prettier quote style in inspirationPrompts

* fix: address review findings on prompt tools (PR #57)

- Guard Enter key against double-submitting an in-flight enhancement
- Skip enhancement when reference files have no prompt text — generate directly
- Gallery reverse-prompt insert now enters image mode (a generation prompt
  lands in the image composer, mirroring use-as-reference)
- Reverse-prompt is a cached TanStack query keyed by file/length/model —
  toggling lengths no longer re-pays tokens; loading spinner keyed to isFetching
- Extract shared Chip component (6 duplicated chip variants)
- Group attachment overlay buttons; drop dead isOpen={true}; document the
  shared vision-model gate on enhance-prompt
- Tests: enter-race + files-only regressions, cache hit, gallery image-mode,
  data-derived inspiration counts, real-store useUiState behavior + persistence

* docs(memory): closeout log for PR #57 review fixes

* fix: gate reverse-prompt warning on models loaded

The no-vision warning flashed on modal open before the models query
resolved. usePromptModel now exposes modelsLoaded and PromptToolsModal
renders the warning only after the list settles.

The no-vision test passed on the initial render regardless of the mock;
it now proves the empty-list branch, and a new test pins the loading
state (no warning, no spinner, no fetch).
